prompt: Audit the alphamind.distillation subpackage (~30 min depth). Findings ordered by what to tackle first.

assertions.text: Report cites at least 3 P-principles (e.g., P1, P3, P5, P7) on findings
Report cites at least 2 reference-thesis IDs (e.g., §A1, §D2, §G1, §J2)
Report identifies the data-pipeline application shape (K3) and applies shape-specific theses
Report references at least one structural-script output (cycle, god-module, antipattern count)
Each finding has a concrete one-line fix paired with the issue
Report ends with an ordered punch list (not just an inventory)
Report identifies at least one load-bearing finding (P-principle violation or structural pathology)
